description: Catalog of agent harnesses — coding-agent runtimes, harness toolkits, and orchestration frameworks used across the FlexNetOS meta workspace.

harnesses.summary: A standalone coding agent with the IDE wired in — a TypeScript/Rust/Bun monorepo (omp) with its own TUI, swarm-extension, and agent/ai packages. Not a Claude Code plugin; a coding-agent harness of its own.
The harness toolkit/landing vendored in this repo at harness/ (skills, docs, site). Source of the `harness` meta-skill that defines specialized agents and the skills they use.
harnesses.notes: Vendored in-repo at harness/ (nested .git stripped). Not a nested-meta child; lives directly in harness_hub's tree.

harnesses.summary: First packaged harness shipped by the harness plugin. An autonomous, resumable, self-restarting Ralph loop (/harness:meta-plugin) that organizes the FlexNetOS meta workspace via harness_hub/meta-plugins/meta_plugin_protocol/meta_plugin_api: hub/registry consistency, cross-repo build/test/lint health, protocol↔consumer drift, and catalog/inventory organization. Run in place or eject into a target repo's .claude/.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness inside the harness plugin (harness/skills/meta-plugin + shared agents in harness/agents/). Invoke /harness:meta-plugin; ejectable via skills/meta-plugin/scripts/eject.sh. Pilot for the packaged-harness convention (docs/packaged-harness-standard.md).
